content: Uca ẓriɣ ijj n lmalak nneɣni ihwa-dd zeg ujenna, tuɣa yarḍ aseynu uca tasřit n wenẓar n ujenna tbedd as x uzeǧif. Aɣembub nnes igga am tfuct, iḍaren nnes am ipilaren n tmessi.
Iṭṭef deg ufus nnes ijj n wedlis ittwannḍen ameẓyan yarzem. Issars aḍar nnes afusi x řebḥar, aḍar nnes azeřmaḍ x temmurt,
uca iřaɣa s tmijja tejhed, am wayrad ittzehharen, uca awarni řami dd-iřaɣa, jjin sebɛa n wajjajen ad sřen tmijjawin nsen.
Řami kemmřen sebɛa n wajjajen nni awař nsen, tuɣa xseɣ ad t ariɣ, maca sřiɣ i yict n tmijja třaɣa-dd zeg ujenna wiss sebɛa: “Egg acemmiɛ x min nnan sebɛa n wajjajen, war t ttari ca.”
Lmalak nni tuɣa ẓriɣ ibedd x řebḥar d temmurt, iksi afus nnes ɣar ujenna
uca ijjuǧ ɣar wenni iddaren i řebda qaɛ, wenni iggin ajenna d min dayes u tammurt d min dayes uřa d řebḥar d min dayes:
Maɣar deg wussan n lmalak wiss sebɛa, xmi ɣa isuḍ netta di řbuq nnes, ggur ad ikmeř ssirr n AREBBI nni tuɣa ittbarreḥ i imsexxaren nnes, inabiyyen.
Uca tmijja zeg ujenna i sřiɣ tessiweř ɣari ict n twařa nneɣnit, tenna: “Uyur, ksi adlis ittwannḍen ameẓyan yarezmen i iǧan deg ufus n lmalak nni ibedden x řebḥar d temmurt.”
Uca uyureɣ ɣar lmalak, ttareɣ as ad ayi iwc adlis ittwannḍen ameẓyan. Inna ayi: “Ksi adlis-a ameẓyan, teccid t uca ad issarzeg aɛeddis nnec, maca deg uqemmum nnec ad yiři d amiẓid am tamment.”
Necc ksiɣ adlis ameẓyan ittwannḍen zeg ufus n lmalak uca cciɣ t. Tuɣa-t d amiẓid deg uqemmum inu, maca řami t cciɣ, yarzeg deg uɛeddis inu.
Xenni inna ayi: “Temmewc as ɛawed řweqt maḥend ad tnebbid i waṭṭas n řegnus d temmura d iřsawen d ijeǧiden.”
